{{Quote|For over a thousand generations, the Jedi Knights were the guardians of peace and justice in the Old Republic. Before the dark times. Before the Empire. A young Jedi named Darth Vader, who was a pupil of mine until he turned to evil, helped the Empire hunt down and destroy the Jedi Knights.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], speaking of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The '''Great Jedi Purge''', later also known as the '''Second Jedi Purge''' or '''Palpatine's Purge''', referred to the efforts initiated by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], upon his [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], to eradicate the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. It resulted in the near-annihilation of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], as it had been with the [[First Jedi Purge]] that occurred after the [[Jedi Civil War]].

The purge officially began with [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], following a [[Showdown on Coruscant|botched attempt]] by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and three other Jedi to arrest then-[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine, who they had learned was in fact the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Sidious. Palpatine deceitfully declared the Jedi to be enemies of the Republic and [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|compelled]] the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to turn on them.

Palpatine, now Emperor of the Galactic Empire, used his new apprentice, Darth Vader, who was formerly the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Anakin Skywalker, and other agents of the Empire to hunt down and kill the remaining Jedi. Some Jedi fought the Empire until their deaths, like [[Roan Shryne]], and those at the [[Conclave on Kessel]]. Others hid from the Empire, like [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].

In the nineteen years that followed Order 66, many Jedi fell to Vader, [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]], [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]], [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], and even [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. The Jedi were also hunted by the [[Emperor's Shadow Guard]]. By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] so few Jedi remained, the Emperor no longer considering the Jedi a threat and ended the Purge.

==History==
===The "Jedi Rebellion"===
{{Main|Showdown on Coruscant}}
{{Quote|In the name of the Galactic Senate of the Republic, you're under arrest, Chancellor.''"<br />"''Are you threatening me, Master Jedi?|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="RotS" />}}
After Anakin Skywalker discovered that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was Darth Sidious, the elusive [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] whom the Jedi had sought for more than a decade, Jedi Master Mace Windu led a small group of Jedi Masters, comprising himself, Agen Kolar, Kit Fisto, and Saesee Tiin, to apprehend Palpatine. Sidious killed Agen Kolar immediately, followed by Saesee Tiin, and, with some greater effort, Kit Fisto, forcing Windu to face the Sith Lord alone.<ref name="RotS" />

[[File:Coruscant_Duel.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] [[Showdown on Coruscant|duel]].]]
In the ensuing battle between Windu and Sidious, the latter was defeated and disarmed mere moments before Anakin entered the room. He then shot [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] at Windu, who deflected the lightning back, twisting Sidious's face, making it appear yellowed and ravaged by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Windu then prepared to finish off Sidious.<ref name="RotS" />

Anakin was driven to betray and incapacitate Windu in order to save Sidious, whom Anakin believed was the only one with sufficient knowledge of the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to save his wife, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], from death. He drew his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to parry Windu's swipe at the Chancellor and through his action, cut off the Jedi Master's saber hand. Then Sidious, who had begged Anakin for help, and had pleaded with Windu not to kill him for his apparent weakness, immediately regained enough strength to blast Master Windu with Force lightning and send him out of the window to his death.<ref name="RotS" />

Anakin was immediately horrified by what he had done, but despite his guilt, or perhaps because of it, he could not overcome the temptation of the dark side, nor could he simply allow Padmé to die when Sidious (allegedly) had the ability to save her. Anakin betrayed the Jedi and swore fealty to Sidious, becoming his new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], and was given the Sith name Darth Vader.<ref name="RotS" />

===Order 66===
{{Main|Order 66/Legends}}
{{Quote|The time has come. Execute Order 66.|Palpatine to numerous [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commanders]]|audio=ExecuteOrder66.flac|<ref name="RotS" />}}
Palpatine wasted no time in deceitfully declaring that the Jedi's attempt to take him into custody constituted a betrayal to the Republic by the Order, and used it to justify his ultimate goals. Palpatine ordered the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to execute Order 66&mdash;the total annihilation of all Jedi "traitors" throughout the entire galaxy as a sign that the age of the Jedi had ended and the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] was now in place.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

In addition to the Jedi's attempt to arrest Palpatine, another reason cited for wiping out the Order was the argument that they were complicit in starting the Clone Wars to destabilize the galaxy and overthrow the government. Facts cited in support of this argument included the Jedi involvement in initiating the creation of the clone army without authorization from the Senate, and the role of former Jedi Count Dooku in forming the Separatist movement.<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

====Assault on the Jedi Temple====
{{Main|Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Skirmish on Shinarcan Bridge Extension}}
{{Quote|We must move quickly. The Jedi are relentless. If they are not all destroyed, it will be civil war without end.|Sidious, to Vader|<ref name="RotS" />}}
[[File:Jedi_Purge.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Clone trooper/Legends|Members]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|wipe out]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].]]
Simultaneously, Sidious dispatched Vader and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to eradicate all the Jedi in their [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="RotS" /> The newly titled Emperor justified his purge with an elaborate conspiracy tale of the Jedi's attempt to take control of the Republic by assassinating the head of government and taking control of the clone army,<ref name="Inaugural Edition">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> using misleading audio recordings of his battle with Mace Windu as evidence.<ref name="RotS novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

The Empire estimated that fewer than one hundred Jedi escaped the betrayal of Vader and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that they were leading during the war.<ref name="Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> Because it was estimated that Jedi Knights were more likely to fall victim to Order 66, it is believed that Jedi Masters were more likely to survive the genocide than Jedi Knights, with the exceptions of few survivors  like [[Ylenic It'kla]], [[Rachi Sitra]], [[Corwin Shelvay/Legends|Corwin Shelvay]] and [[Empatojayos Brand]]. Among the few survivors were Jedi Masters: [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], [[Echuu Shen-Jon]], [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]], [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], [[K'Kruhk]], [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]], [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]], [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]].<ref name="RotS" /> Many Jedi that did survive, like [[Kai Hudorra]] and [[Roan Shryne]], cast aside their lightsabers, realizing that their roles as keepers of the peace were over, only to be cut down by Darth Vader himself. Other Jedi, such as [[Olee Starstone]] and [[Dass Jennir]], kept fighting the Empire, and tried to contact the other Jedi.<ref name="Dark Lord" /> Kenobi and Yoda secretly escaped to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], respectively.<ref name="RotS novel" /> Rahm Kota secretly attacked many Imperial shipments and traveled all over the galaxy being a thorn in the side of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFUcg">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> However, before hiding, Obi-Wan and Yoda altered a return call being sent from the Temple into a warning to stay away; as a result, several other Jedi survived the immediate purge.<ref name="RotS" /> Most survivors fell to Vader, but some others fell to [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunters]], including the Emperor's Hands, [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], and even a handful of bounty hunters.<ref name="Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties" /><ref name="NEC" />

===Initial actions===
{{Main|Conclave on Kessel}}
{{Quote|In having survived, Yoda and Obi-Wan aren't exceptions to the rule. I'm certain that dozens of Jedi escaped with their lives, and in due time you will have the pleasure of killing many of them. But of greater importance is the fact that their order has been crushed. Finished, Lord Vader. Do I make myself clear?|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to Vader|<ref name="Purge">[[Purge (comic book)|''Purge'']]</ref>}}
About one month after Order 66 was issued, the Jedi [[Shadday Potkin/Legends|Shadday Potkin]] called for a Conclave on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] to discuss options against the Imperial campaign to wipe out the remaining Jedi. A group of seven surviving Jedi, including [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] and [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]], gathered on Kessel. However, the conclave was a ruse to trap and kill Vader.

A false rumor that his former Master, Obi-Wan Kenobi, would be among the Jedi motivated Vader to act. Despite Obi-Wan's absence, Vader demanded his location from the Jedi, threatening them with death. They did not cooperate with his request (in truth, none of them knew where Kenobi was anyway) and, although they put up a valiant fight, no Jedi survived. Potkin's trap for Vader resulted in nothing more than the deaths of more Jedi.<ref name="Purge" />

[[File:Kesselconclave.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Jedi of the [[Conclave on Kessel]]]]
Rumors spread that the conclave consisted of fifty Jedi, each easily killed by the Dark Lord. In truth, Darth Vader fought only eight with difficulty. However, to cement Vader's image and invoke fear in the remaining Jedi, the Emperor declared the rumors true. Official reports, fabricated by [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], stated that some of the Jedi had either been executed for numerous crimes, or that they killed each other in duels for leadership.<ref name="Purge" />

Immediately after Order 66 was issued, Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and survivor [[Olee Starstone]] began searching for any surviving Jedi. One destination she investigated was [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], where Masters Yoda, [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] had been stationed when the Order was transmitted from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She arrived on the planet along with several other Jedi survivors&mdash;[[Siadem Forte]], [[Deran Nalual]], [[Klossi Anno]], [[Iwo Kulka]], [[Jambe Lu]], and [[Nam Poorf]], as well as the slicer [[Filli Bitters]]. After meeting with [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], the Jedi learned of Yoda's survival. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] offered the band of Jedi safe harbor on Kashyyyk, but a [[CR25 troop carrier/Legends|CR25 troop carrier]] arrived at [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], interrupting their meeting.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Not long after the arrival of the Jedi, the Sith Lord Darth Vader had arrived in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]], along with the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Exactor/Legends|Exactor]]'', where it joined [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and [[Executrix/Legends|''Executrix'']]. The two planned their attack on Kashyyyk&mdash;Vader interested in destroying the fugitive Jedi, Tarkin interested in enslaving the Wookiees for use in the construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Although the fleet commanders were eager to bombard the planet, Vader overruled them, ordering a direct assault on several cities including Kachirho, [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]], [[Kepitenochan/Legends|Kepitenochan]], [[Okikuti]], and [[Chenachochan]].<ref name="Dark Lord" />

At Kachirho, the landed Imperial troops ordered the Wookiees to hand over the fugitive Jedi. The enraged Wookiees attacked the troops, and Starstone and her Jedi soon joined the battle. As more Imperial forces landed, the Wookiee warriors and the Jedi covered the evacuation of Kachirho, as countless Wookiees fled the Imperial troopers, fleeing from enslavement. Imperial landers and gunships were engaged by [[Oevvaor jet catamaran/Legends|Oevvaor jet catamarans]], retrofitted with rocket launchers and other high-end military hardware, salvaged by the Wookiees from the remnants left over by the earlier [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Meanwhile, Vader piloted a [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class shuttle]]. Eventually making a landing at Kachirho, Vader was confronted by Starstone and her Jedi cadre. Vader killed Forte and Kulka, and injured Lu, Poorf, and Anno, leaving only himself and Starstone in the fight.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

The two briefly faced off, but Jedi Master Roan Shryne and the smuggler [[Archyr Beil]] arrived and intervened. Shryne slew [[Appo/Legends|Appo]] while Archyr dealt with the rest of the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and Shryne moved in to engage Vader in a vicious battle, buying Starstone and Archyr more time to escape with the injured Jedi. As Shryne and Vader dueled, the main battle began to drift east of the city, moving closer to the lake, as Imperial gunships and artillery drove the Wookiees down out of the city and towards the ground.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Abruptly, the Imperial gunships began to retreat from Kachirho, as the orbiting Star Destroyers began their orbital bombardment. Shryne and Vader's duel was interrupted by the strike, and the two moved inside one of the great [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]]. Once inside, Vader used [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force throw]] to throw planks of wood and other debris at Shryne, critically injuring the Jedi in the process and throwing him down from a high bridge. Seeing that Shryne was going to die, Vader chose not to finish off the Jedi, instead revealing his true identity to the man&mdash;Anakin Skywalker, who would be redeemed by his son, Luke Skywalker, during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Dark Lord" /><ref name="rotj">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

As Shryne passed away, [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] began to descend into the atmosphere, finishing the conquest of Kashyyyk. About two hundred thousand Wookiees, including Tarfful, were captured and moved to containment camps on the [[Wawaatt Archipelago/Legends|Wawaatt Archipelago]].<ref name="Dark Lord" />
As a result, the Empire gained control of Kashyyyk, and gained a valuable labor source for the Death Star project.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Shortly thereafter, another Jedi was discovered taking refuge on Kashyyyk, and Darth Vader led an army, cutting through the forests trying to find him. [[Kento Marek]] was found and executed in front of his own son, [[Galen Marek|Galen]]. Vader sensed potential in the boy, for Galen had actually used his Force abilities to pull Vader's lightsaber out of his hand. When a stormtrooper squad arrived to execute the boy, Vader killed them all, leaving no witnesses, and secretly took the boy under his training.

===Imperial expansion===
[[File:Naboofight.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The [[Battle of Naboo (Imperial Period)|Battle of Naboo]]]]
{{Quote|The Emperor took whatever steps he felt necessary to reduce the risk of civil war. Whatever else can be said about them, the Jedi were potential insurgents who he felt could not be trusted with power.|[[Ohran Keldor]]|<ref name="CoJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>}}
{{Main|Battle of Naboo (Imperial Period)}}
The monarch of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]], decided that the situation called for military&mdash;not diplomatic&mdash;action. She started sheltering fugitive Jedi on the run from the Empire. To crush the uprising on Palpatine's homeworld, the 501st Legion invaded [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and rushed into the plaza supported by [[TX-130T fighter tank]]s after disabling an [[Autoturret/Legends|auto-turret]] grid. The Jedi were killed by the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and Apailana was shot and killed by a sniper. With Naboo in line, the 501st gained the nickname "Vader's Fist."<ref name="swb2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

Some years later, a surviving Separatist named [[Gizor Dellso]] found refuge on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Dellso was the designer of the droid army deactivation signal, and using his knowledge, reactivated a dormant droid army on the planet and planned a revolution. Similarly, the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] government planned action against the Empire and had grown a clone army. The Clone Wars nearly began again, but Vader's Fist put down both of the revolts.<ref name="swb2" />

===Further actions===
[[File:Fleeing_Imperial_Pursuit_FDCR.png|thumb|left|250px|Two Jedi fleeing from pursuing Imperial stormtroopers.]]
During the purge, Vader wiped out the farming colony of [[Talasea]] for harboring a Jedi.<ref name="Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties" /> Vader and a number of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] also killed the [[last Curator of Records]] on [[Toola/Legends|Toola]].<ref name="copl1">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

In [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], Inquisitor [[Antinnis Tremayne]] captured and tortured Jedi Master [[Darrin Arkanian]] and his apprentice, [[Corwin Shelvay/Legends|Corwin Shelvay]], on Coruscant. In an escape attempt, Tremayne killed Arkanian in a lightsaber duel, only to have Shelvay seriously wound him before making it offworld. Tremayne required [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] to recover, and was afterward dispatched by Vader aboard [[Interrogator/Legends|''Interrogator'']] to scour the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] for Shelvay.<ref name="Dark Vendetta">{{GalaxyCite|8|Dark Vendetta (short story)}}</ref> Around this time, [[Imperial Sentinel]]s were sent off [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] for the first time, to capture [[Ashka Boda]]. Bringing him to Coruscant in an [[Lictor-class dungeon ship|Imperial dungeon ship]], Palpatine killed him and took the [[Tedryn Holocron]].<ref name="Dark Empire endnotes">[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]]</ref>

===Rebel foundations===
{{Main|Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|Starkiller's Trial of Skill|First mission to Raxus Prime|Starkiller's Trial of Insight|Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)}}
Around 17 years into the purge, Jedi survivor [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] organized a [[Kota's Militia|militia]] and began attacking various Imperial targets. This was an attempt to lure Darth Vader out. Eventually attacking the [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility]] over [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Vader sent his apprentice, [[Galen Marek]], Starkiller, to eliminate him, rather than coming personally as Kota expected. Kota was presumed dead in the ensuing battle, but somehow managed to survive the duel.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

[[File:TwilekJedi-TFUCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Jedi defends rebel troops from advancing stormtroopers]]
Starkiller, a tool of Vader's used in his plot to overthrow Palpatine, was sent on two further assassination missions: [[Kazdan Paratus]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] and [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. Paratus had gone mad and built a junk replica of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Raxus Prime, complete with mock statues of each of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] members, but was killed by Starkiller, along with his mock statues of the Jedi Council members being destroyed. Shaak Ti prepared for a possible revolution against the Sith, with her Padawan [[Maris Brood]]. She trained the native [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucians]] to use the Force and organized them. When Starkiller arrived, the two dueled on a massive [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]] pit. Ti warned Starkiller of the nature of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]] before falling into the pit.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed" />

{{Main|Battle aboard the Empirical|Starkiller's Trial of the Spirit}}
Palpatine's spies had tracked Vader's apprentice back to the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. There, Palpatine ordered Vader to kill Starkiller. Palpatine would later find use of Vader's apprentice, and had Vader retrieve his body and bring him back to life, giving him a new mission: gather the enemies of the Empire into one place. Vader disguised this order as another plot to overthrow Palpatine by giving him something else to pay attention to: an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|army of dissidents and rebels.]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed" />

This new mission would lead to Starkiller tracking down a (alive) General Rahm Kota, who was blinded following his duel with Starkiller and became a drunk, supposedly losing his connection with the Force. Kota would lead him to rescue [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]. Him and Bail talked of rebellion, and would agree that they would need to show other possible rebels that the Empire was indeed vulnerable. This mission led him to destroy a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] construction facility over [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. This act would inspire senators [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] to join Rahm, Marek, Leia and Bail Organa to sign the [[Corellian Treaty]] and officially organize the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

During this meeting on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Vader raided, revealing his ruse, and brought the rebel senators to be tortured, interrogated, and executed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]]. Marek would realize his inner [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] self, traveling to the Death Star and nearly killing both [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], allowing the senators and Rahm to escape. He would lose his life in the process. The [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] had officially started, which began to draw the Empire away from their Jedi hunting and toward destroying the rebellion Palpatine had accidentally created.
[[File:Vader-Anya.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] [[Duel on Cophrigin V|attacks]] the [[The Dark Woman|Dark Woman]] on [[Cophrigin V]].]]
Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Vader tracked a [[Dargulli Dark Jedi|female Human Dark Jedi]] down on the planet [[Dargulli/Legends|Dargulli]]. Despite the fact that she wished to become his Sith apprentice, Vader killed her.<ref name="Star Wars: Empire: Betrayal">''[[Star Wars: Empire: Betrayal]]''</ref> Around this time, Vader also [[Duel on Cophrigin V|killed]] the [[The Dark Woman|Dark Woman]], who had been found on [[Cophrigin V]] by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].<ref name="Darth Vader: Extinction">{{Tales|issue1=1|issue2=2|Extinction}}</ref> Throughout the Purge, [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] aided Vader and his agents in hunting Jedi within the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].<ref name="Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The old Jedi order died with the Old Republic. Then there was Luke, and only Luke, and a lot of fumbling to re-create Jedi from what little he knew of them. He did the best he could, and he made mistakes. I was one of them. His generation of Jedi was put together like a rickety space scow, but from it something new has emerged. It's not the old Jedi order, nor should it be.|[[Kyp Durron]]|<ref name="Edge of Victory II" />}}
By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the systematic Purge had concluded, but a few of the survivors would die in the years that followed&mdash;including [[Echuu Shen-Jon]], killed by Vader on [[Krant]], and Obi-Wan Kenobi, who sacrificed himself on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] to ensure the escape of his protégé, Luke Skywalker.<ref name="ANH" /><ref name="Darth Vader: Extinction" /> As the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] turned in favor of the Rebels, surviving Jedi began to come out of hiding, becoming members of the Alliance, even sacrificing their lives for the return of the Republic and democracy. Famous examples include Echuu Shen-Jon, Rahm Kota, Qu Rahn, [[Corwin Shelvay/Legends|Corwin Shelvay]] and [[Rachi Sitra]].

[[File:Hidden_Sanctuary_FDCR.png|thumb|right|250px|Survivors of the Purge training at a [[Unidentified Jedi sanctuary|hidden sanctuary]]]]
Four years after Kenobi's death, Yoda died at the old age of 900 and Anakin Skywalker, formerly Darth Vader, redeemed himself by sacrificing himself to save his son from being killed by Palpatine on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="rotj" /> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], one year after the Battle of Endor,<ref name="Saga6">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050616a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 6: Outcasts and Megalomaniacs Welcome}}</ref> Jedi Master [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]] was captured by the [[Seven Dark Jedi]], and after a short but ferocious duel, he was cut down by<ref name="DF2">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref> the former Jedi turned [[Inquisitorius/Legends|inquisitor]]<ref name="Saga6" /> [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] aboard his [[Vengeance (Vengeance-class)|flagship]].<ref name="DF2" /> The known surviving Jedi would even join the [[New Jedi Order]];<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> in addition, seven years after the Battle of Endor, [[Empatojayos Brand]] sacrificed himself to destroy the spirit of Palpatine on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="EE 2">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref>

The Jedi Purge was intended not only to symbolically and literally exterminate the entire Jedi Order, but also to consolidate the Jedi's history, knowledge, and technology into Palpatine's possession. Many [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]], ancient techniques, training materials, and Jedi antiquities were lost. This was primarily due to the efforts of Darth Vader; the Inquisitorius, Dark Jedi whose specific purpose was to seek out and destroy the vestiges of the Jedi Order; and the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], which was responsible for erasing the Order's memories.<ref name="Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties" /> During his efforts to reestablish the order<ref name="Edge of Victory II">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>, Luke Skywalker and his relic hunters did intensive research to locate even the smallest scraps of information pertaining to the old Order, most notably on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] where the Jedi artifacts were located during the reign of the reborn Palpatine in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="DEII 3">[[Dark Empire II 3|''Dark Empire II'' 3]]</ref> However, not all of the Jedi's writings and teachings were lost forever; in the years after the Second Jedi Purge even up to the events after the [[Third Jedi Purge]], ancient Jedi artifacts were rediscovered by the New Jedi Order across the galaxy, most notably on homeworlds that played a strong role in the history of the Jedi Order, like [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], Ossus, [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], etc.

===Later casualties===
{{Quote|We are not altogether alone in the galaxy, you and I. But I doubt that we can rely on help from others of our kind.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], beginning [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] Jedi training|<ref name="SWradio">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
Many Jedi survived the initial execution of Order 66 and went into hiding. Some succeeded in avoiding the Empire; however, others were eventually tracked down and destroyed.

As [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] places both the beginning of the Purge and Palpatine obtaining the Holocron in 19 BBY, Baas' death occurs in the same year.</ref>

Hudorra wounded the fallen Jedi in a duel, then shortly afterwards [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] arrived on [[Kestavel]]. Hudorra was killed by Darth Vader in a duel in his own casino.

===Known survivors or unaccounted Jedi as of the end of the Purge; [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]===
{{Quote|I guess your purge wasn't efficient enough, Vader!|[[Echuu Shen-Jon]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
As of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], it was generally accepted that the Great Jedi Purge had concluded after nearly nineteen years of systematic Jedi slaughter. While any surviving Jedi were still to be executed on sight, the Empire was no longer assigning active searches. The Emperor knew there were still survivors, yet they were deemed too few to pose a threat. Though dozens of Jedi were unaccounted for, only around thirty Jedi Masters, Knights, Padawans and Initiates who still followed the Jedi way were definitively known to be alive by this point.

{{ScrollBox|
*Grand Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]: Survived in hiding on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] until his death in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="rotj" />
*Master [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]]: Founded split faction of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] called the [[Altisian Jedi]]. The [[Altisian Jedi]], served in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] not as generals but as healers helping refugees. With the execution of Order 66, the [[Altisian Jedi]] were forced to go underground. Eventually coming into contact with other Jedi survivors, they formed a movement to smuggle out anyone who was on the run from Imperial authorities. Master Altis used his ship the [[Chu'unthor (Clone Wars)]] as the headquarters of the movement and hid Jedi survivors there.
*Master [[Aqinos]]: Excommunicated by the Jedi Order; joined the [[New Jedi Order]] only to be killed in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
*Master [[Ood Bnar]]: In tree-state on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] for the past several millennia. Awakened in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] to save [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] before being destroyed.<ref name="DEII 3" />
*Lady [[Caryn (Jedi)|Caryn]]: Trained [[Ana Tathis]] during the Dark Times before disappearing again.
*Master [[Thracia Cho Leem]]: Survived by virtue of the fact that she was not an active member of the Order.
*Master [[Minos Fel'Kona]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and went into hiding.
*Master [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and went into hiding with [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]] and his son [[Korto Vos]]
*Master [[Kina Ha]]: Survived after being transported to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] by [[Nyreen Vollen]].
*Master [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]]: Hid on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]; corrupted by the dark side, reemerging as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] in over a hundred years later.<ref name="leg16">[[Legacy (2006) 16|''Legacy'' (2006) 16]]</ref>
*Master [[Ikrit]]: Not an active member of the Order; in stasis on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="jjk1">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: The Golden Globe]]''</ref>
*Master [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]]: Survived the explosion of the [[Shadowblade]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Was placed into a protective chamber by his droid [[R-0]]. His fate after that is unknown.
*Master [[Dass Jennir]]: Survived with the help of a group of former separatists and smugglers.
*Master [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]]: Survived under the Empire as part of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]]; killed by [[Kyle Katarn]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="Saga6" />
*Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]: Survived in hiding on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]; killed by Darth Vader on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ANH" />
*Master [[K'Kruhk]]: Survived Order 66 with the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]] and [[Chase Piru]] and rebuild the [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Hidden Temple]] with the help of Master Zao. Long after the Purge, he reemerged as a Master and a Councilor of the [[New Jedi Order]].
*Master [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]: Survived to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="tfu">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>
*Master [[Celeste Morne]]: Survived in stasis from the [[Old Republic era]]. Used as a pawn by Darth Vader, until escaping, living until sacrificing herself to kill [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="reb15">[[Rebellion 15|''Rebellion'' 15]]</ref>
*Master [[Plett]]: Survived at a [[Plett's Well|secret base]] giving refuge to Jedi children.
*Master [[Quarmall]]: Wounded during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] where he fell to the dark side, becoming a [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]].
*Master [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]]: Joined the Rebel Alliance; aided [[Kyle Katarn]] until his death at the hands of [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].
*Master [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] alongside Tholme; rejoined the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="THE">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Hidden Enemy]]''</ref> Sacrificed herself during the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple]] on [[Taivas]] in [[138 ABY]].
*Master [[Echuu Shen-Jon]]: Had left the Order after falling to the dark side during the Clone Wars; eventually killed by Darth Vader.<ref name="GB" />
*Master [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]]: Survived until his death after the Purge's end.<ref name="leg2">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref>
*Master [[Vhiin Thorla]]: Survived the Great Jedi Purge. Captured by [[Valin Draco]] and [[Raik Muun]]. Forced to kill his Padawan [[Dorv'Tilsta]] after he fell to the dark side.
*Master [[Vamilad]]: Survived Order 66 and was shortly thereafter contacted by [[Antarian Rangers|Antarian Ranger]] [[Jilam Kester]].
*Master [[Zao]]: Survived Order 66 by virtue of the fact that he was not an active member of the Order. Later helped Master K'kruhk to rebuild the [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Hidden Temple]] but left the shelter several months later when a perturbed youngling fled and the two never came back.<ref name="ItU" />
*Master [[Arligan Zey]]: Survived after being taken to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] by [[Maze]].
*Knight [[Tiberus Anderlock/Legends|Tiberus Anderlock]]: Survived Order 66 and the Purge only to die shortly after the battle of Yavin in a dogfight with Imperial forces.
*Former Knight [[Force vampire|Tel Angor]]: Turned to the dark side by an experiment gone wrong. He became a [[Force vampire|Force Vampire]], he hunted down and killed the members of the [[Order of the Silver Jedi]]. Eventually left for dead in a derelict ship, he was found later by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] troops and set free.
*Knight [[Fable Astin/Legends|Fable Astin]]: Trained as a Jedi by her mother who was a Jedi who had fallen in love with her own Padawan. Fable was raised and trained as a Jedi during the Dark Times, this marked her as one of the few Jedi to live during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
*Knight [[Beldorion]]: Survived by falling to the dark side; became a tyrant. Hunted down and killed by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].<ref name="Planet of Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>
*Knight [[Empatojayos Brand]]: Survived to join the Rebel Alliance. Maimed by Darth Vader,<ref name="DEII 4">[[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]]</ref> survived to destroy the reborn Emperor.<ref name="EE 2">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref>
*Knight [[Nej'a Berto'Lo]]: Survived Order 66 and the Purge only to die in a dogfight after the Battle of Yavin with Imperial forces.
*Former Knight [[Valin Draco]]: A respected Jedi during the Clone Wars. Left for dead after the [[Battle of Parein II 4/Legends|Battle of Parein II 4]]. He fell to the dark side and became an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]].
*Knight [[Markus Dorivonn]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] only to end up traveling with other Jedi survivors searching for a lost holocron before the battle of Yavin.
*Knight [[Elaiza]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] as she was on a meditative retreat after experiencing the horrors of the Clone Wars. Fled to her homeworld of Nar Shaddaa where she disappeared into the crowds of that world in order to hide amongst them.
*Knight [[Neth Enasteri]]: Fled to [[Rhamalai]]; eventually leaving to avoid the Imperial garrison there.
*Knight [[Gel (Jedi)|Gel]]: Survived in hiding; eventually discovered and killed by [[Tol Skaros]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Child of Light">"[[Child of Light]]"</ref>
*Knight [[Gilflyn]]: Fell to the dark side at some point and ended up hunting down Jedi survivors or other force sensitives around the galaxy.
*Knight [[Halbret]]: Placed into stasis by the [[Kathol (species)|Kathol]] in the [[Pius Dea Era]]. Later awakened in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] by the crew of the [[FarStar]]. She sacrificed her life in order to stop the [[DarkStryder]].
*Knight [[Ylenic It'kla]]: Killed during the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>
*Knight [[Jorad]]: A [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] who survived the Great Jedi Purge. Captured by members of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]]. Fell to the Dark Side and became an Inquisitor.
*Former Knight [[Kadann]]: Embraced the dark side and left the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Joined the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]]. Trained [[Jedgar]] in the ways of the dark side.
*Knight [[Jhor-Kai]]: Lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altikar IV]]. Trained [[Sha'lia]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Killed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] prior to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
*Knight [[Kaoln]]: Survived the Jedi Purge, smuggled arms for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

*Knight [[Matarmeno Krahnn]]: Went into hiding on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

*[[Jedi Shadow|Shadow]] [[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]]: Captured by Inquisitor [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]]; turned to the dark side. Killed by [[Kyle Katarn]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="TDFS4">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050526a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 4: Of the Crudest Matter}}</ref>
*Knight [[Meloria]]: Born some thirty years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. While on a mission to catch a bounty hunter, she killed an innocent bystander. In her grief, she fled to [[Drall (planet)|Drall]], and placed herself into a cryogenic chamber where she could never use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] again.

*Knight [[Rune]]: A [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] Jedi who escaped [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. A bounty was placed on his head and in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he was killed by a bounty hunter and the bounty on his head was collected.
*Knight [[Seek Ryontarr]]: A [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] Jedi who was sent to the planet [[Nath Goordi]] to rescue the royal heirs. The heirs never returned to their homeworld. Luke Skywalker, while traveling to the [[Sinkhole Station]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], found out that Seek had joined the [[Mind Walkers]]. Seek's body died while he was in the realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] known as [[Beyond shadows]].

*Knight [[Corwin Shelvay/Legends|Corwin Shelvay]]: Survived to join the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="gg9" />
*Knight [[Kara Shuba]]: Fled to [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]], where she developed the reputation as a crazy beggar to avoid detection from the local Imperial garrison.

*Knight [[Taselda]]: Sent to [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] with [[Beldorion]] roughly [[400 BBY/Legends|four hundred years]] before the Great Jedi Purge. Where they both fell to the Dark Side.
*Knight [[Damien Tantrellius]]: Lost his memory, became an [[Actor/Legends|actor]].<ref name="fg88">[[Space Gamer/Fantasy Gamer 88|''Space Gamer/Fantasy Gamer'' 88]]</ref>
*Knight [[Dorn Tavers]]: Survived the initial stages of the Great Jedi Purge. Joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
*Knight [[Warl Thimbus]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], commanded Rebel troops at the [[Battle of Taul|First Battle of Taul]].
*Knight [[Travgen]]: Survived on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] guarding over the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]].
*Knight [[Bre'ano Umakk]]: A [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] jedi who survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and fled to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].
*Knight [[Trilinae Untaire]]: A friend of [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]], she survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], by being dropped off on an unknown world by [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Mar'ek]].
*Knight [[Urootar]]: Killed on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="swg1">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
*Knight [[Sarn Vals]]: Unknown fate after being tracked to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].
*Knight [[Vergere]]: Not in the known galaxy at the time; considered lost to the Order. Died saving [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] during the [[Battle of Ebaq]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].
*Knight [[Vima-Da-Boda]]: Survived in hiding on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Dark Empire endnotes" />
*Knight [[Roni von Wasaki]]: Kept in stasis from the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]]; may have joined the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="difa">{{ChallengeCite|66|Disturbance in the Force (article)}}</ref>
*Knight [[Suljo Warde]]: Fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Eventually fell to the dark side and exiled himself to the ancient sith homeworld of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Chronicles of the Gatekeeper">''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]''</ref>
*Knight [[Antaria Wellos]]: Went into hiding on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].

*Iron Knight [[Luxum (Jedi)|Luxum]]: Trained by [[Aqinos]]. Excommunicated from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Went into hiding on [[Dweem]] with the rest of the [[Iron Knight]]s. Joined the [[New Jedi Order]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] she fell to the Dark Side.
*Iron Knight [[Ilum (Jedi)|Ilum]]: Trained by [[Aqinos]]. Excommunicated by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Went into hiding on [[Dweem]] with the rest of the [[Iron Knight]]s. Joined the [[New Jedi Order]].

He was later discovered with his friend [[Nia]] by [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[HOB-147]]. He spared their lives when Coyle's Ship was boarded by a patrol of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] looking for Jedi Survivors.

*Padawan [[Shen-Ji Collun]]: Dispatched to the planet [[Daimar]], in order to train in diplomacy. When [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was initiated she was spared from being executed. She aided the resistance on the planet when the Empire blockaded it.
*Former Padawan [[Winslau Da'k]]: Fell to the Dark Side after having an encounter with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Imprisoned his former master [[Winslau Da'k's Jedi Master]] on [[Morcanth]]. He was eventually killed by agents from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and members of the [[New Jedi Order]].
*Padawan [[Dray (Fallen Jedi)|Dray]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], and became the gatekeeper of a holocron. He eventually made his way to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where he met [[Finn Galfridian]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. He gave Finn the holocron which would only activate for him, eventually Dray revealed himself to be a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].
*Padawan [[Gruu Dunrik]]: Survived to join the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="resb">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref>
*Padawan [[Ekria/Legends|Ekria]]: Survived in hiding after nearly dying at Vader's blade.
*Padawan [[Gerrick]]: Received training as a Jedi, he was alive during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
*Padawan [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]]: Survived at Plett's Well; fell to the dark side. Killed by her son [[Irek Ismaren]] on Coruscant in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="EL2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>
*Former Padawan [[Jedgar]]: He had visions of both the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the Great Jedi Purge. Left the Jedi Order when he was assigned to the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]]. Fell to the Dark Side and was trained by [[Kadann]]. Joined the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]].
*Padawan [[Drakka Judarrl]]: Survived on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] aiding the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="swg1" />
*Padawan [[Kendalina]]: Survived to become a nurse at an Imperial asylum.
*Padawan [[Danaan Kerr]]:Captured by Palpatine; trained in the dark side and set lose on the galaxy.<ref name="WBC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>
*Former Padawan [[Ephaan Kenzon]]: Survived after resigning from the Order. Opened the [[School of Hidden Wisdom]].
*Former Padawan [[Sinsor Khal]]: Survived in the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] as a scientist.<ref name="theapp">{{GamerCite|8|The Apprentice (short story)}}</ref>
*Padawan [[Lilith]]: Fell to the dark side and joined the Empire; assisted in hunting Jedi.
*Padawan [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]]: Survived an encounter with Darth Vader; went into hiding.
*Padawan [[Nichos Marr/Legends|Nichos Marr]]: Survived at [[Plett's Well]]; joined the [[New Jedi Order]]. Helped destroy the ''Eye of Palpatine'' in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], but doesn't survive it.<ref name="Death date">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] establishes that Marr [[Death/Legends|died]] shortly prior to the events of the novel, which is dated to [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>
*Padawan [[Ull Murub]]: Survived at Sullust with his master.<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
*Former Padawan [[Raik Muun]]: Dismissed from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. She fell to the Dark Side and Joined the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].
*Padawan [[Noirah Na]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and went into hiding forsaking the Jedi Ways.
*Padawan [[Lora Nadad]]: Survived the [[Destruction of the Almas Academy]] and [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. In hiding on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
*Padawan [[Deran Nalual]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. Decided to work to sabotage the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
*Padawan [[Nia]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Transported by [[Hurd Coyle]] on his ship. She was later discovered with her friend [[Bon (Jedi)|Bon]] by [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[HOB-147]]. He spared their lives when Coyle's Ship was boarded by a patrol of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] looking for Jedi Survivors.
*Padawan [[Nyo]]: Trained as a Jedi by the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of Master [[Aryzah]] during the Jedi Purge.
*Former Padawan [[Ferus Olin]]: Survived, causing mayhem amongst Imperial-controlled worlds. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] he is killed by Darth Vader on a [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]] moon, and his body was found by Princess Leia (whom he died for).
*Padawan [[Diala Passil/Legends|Diala Passil]]: Survived Order 66 when her master did not. She vowed not to forget her fallen master's teachings. She later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
*Padawan [[Chase Piru]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and hid during the Purge at the [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Hidden Temple]] with Master [[K'Kruhk|K'kruhk]] and [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|younglings]] of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]].
*Padawan [[Jin-Lo Rayce]]: Survived the attack on the Jedi Temple; founded the [[Agents of Ossus]].
*Padawan [[Joc Sah]]: While on a mission on [[Ragmar V]], he was attacked by his former clone soldiers. After defeating them, he was offered to join the local resistance led by [[Gaan]]. More clone troopers were sent down to the planet to make sure Sah was dead. With the help of Gaan's militia they fended off the attack and were able to escape. Both men would lead hit-and-run attacks against the clones on Ragmar V.
*Former Padawan [[Sardoth]]: Fell to the Dark Side before the Clone Wars. Helped the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] hunt down Jedi during the Great Jedi Purge. He was betrayed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. He fled to [[Ahakista/Legends|Ahakista]] and became the owner of [[Daystar Casino/Legends|Daystar Casino]].
*Padawan [[Olee Starstone]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Participated in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. Decide to go into exile secretly working to oppose the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
*Padawan [[Kajin Savaros]]: A young man with an incredible affinity for [[The Force/Legends|The Force]]. He was never selected by the Jedi Order to receive training in order to master his abilities. When the Jedi Order was destroyed as a result of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Kajin went underground as the Empire was seeking out any force sensitive individuals who would either be killed or made to serve the Emperor. Kajin eventually ran into Jax Pavan, a Jedi Knight who had managed to survive the destruction of the Jedi Order. Pavan took Kajin under his wing and trained him as a Jedi in order to help Kajin to have better control over his raw Force abilities.
*Padawan [[Ana Tathis]]: Trained as a Jedi by [[Caryn (Jedi)|Caryn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
*Padawan [[Antinnis Tremayne]]: Captured during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He fell to the Dark Side and became an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]].
*Padawan [[Wise Man of Kooroo|Glovan Thule]]: Survived in hiding, not considered a threat by the Empire.<ref name="psg1">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>
*Padawan [[Torva/Legends|Torva]]: One of the few Jedi to train during the reign of the Empire. Torva aspired to be a Jedi Knight after discovering her Force potential. She wielded a blue bladed lightsaber pike. She traveled the galaxy visiting various planets on her journey to become a Jedi.
*Former Padawan [[Codi Ty]]: Excommunicated by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]; not pursued by the Empire.
*Padawan [[Misha Vekkian]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Fell to the Dark Side and became a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].
*Initiate [[Genel]]: A member of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]]. Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and hid during the Purge at the [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Hidden Temple]] with Master K'kruhk and the Hawkbats.
*Initiate [[Jiro (Jedi)|Jiro]]: A member of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]]. Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and hid during the Purge at the [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Hidden Temple]] with Master K'kruhk and the Hawkbats.
*Initiate [[Nable]]: A member of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]]. Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and hid during the Purge at the [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Hidden Temple]] with Master K'kruhk and the Hawkbats.
*Initiate [[Onkya]]: A member of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]]. Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and hid during the Purge at the [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Hidden Temple]] with Master K'kruhk and the Hawkbats.
*Initiate [[Kennan Taanzer]]: A member of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]]. Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and hid during the Purge at the [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Hidden Temple]] with Master K'kruhk and the Hawkbats.
*Initiate [[Seddwia]]: A member of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]]. Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and hid during the Purge at the [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Hidden Temple]] with Master K'kruhk and the Soaring Hawkbats.
*Initiate [[Sidirri]]: A member of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]]. Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] but fled the [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Hidden Temple]] and her Clan after having used the Dark Side. She's never heard from again.
*A [[Unidentified Togorian youngling|Togorian Initiate]]: A member of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]]. Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and hid during the Purge at the [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Hidden Temple]] with Master K'kruhk and the Hawkbats.
*A [[Unidentified Human male youngling|Human Initiate]]: A member of the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]]. Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and hid during the Purge at the [[Hidden Temple (Arkinnea)|Hidden Temple]] with Master K'kruhk and the Hawkbats.
*Former [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]] Member [[Malleus]]: Formerly known as Telloti Cillmam'n. Telloti failed to become a Padawan prior to the Clone Wars. While exploring the planet [[Nicht Ka]], he discovered the armor of [[Warb Null]]. After the armor gave him visions of the Dark Side and its power, donned the ancient armor, forsake his name and identity, instead calling himself Malleus. He [[Duel on Nicht Ka|slew]] the other Jedi who were with him just as they received a message from Supreme Chancellor Palpatine that the Clone Wars was over and they must return to the temple on Coruscant.
*[[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] Member [[Gwellib Ap-Llewff]]: Captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and became an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]].
*[[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] Member [[Halmere]]: Captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and became an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]].
*[[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] Member [[Jambe Lu]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Participated in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. Decided to work to sabotage the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
*[[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] Member [[Lanu Pasiq]]: Captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and became an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]].
*[[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] Member [[Nam Poorf]]: Survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Participated in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. Decided to work to sabotage the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
*[[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] Member [[Sarcev Quest]]: Fell to the Dark Side and became an [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]]. Executed in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]] by [[Jeng Droga]] for destroying Palpatine's clones.
*[[Ull Murub's master]]: Survived with their Padawan on Sullust.<ref name="GORW" />
*[[Force Adept]] [[Valara Saar]]: Not part of the Order proper; survived in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].
*Former Jedi [[Set Harth]], while not affiliated with the Order for almost a thousand years, he still managed to survive at least until the Yuuzhan Vong War.}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
{{Main|Battle of Shumari}}
In the [[Battle of Shumari]], perhaps the most devastating event of the Great Jedi Purge, legions of Imperial troops under Vader's command clashed with a considerable number of Order 66 Jedi survivors. At the end of the battle, all Jedi but [[Tao (Sith Apprentice)|one]] had been killed, many by Vader himself. [[Shumari]] had been subjected to heavy [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] by orbiting Star Destroyers while the planetside battle raged, which devastated the planet completely, rendering it uninhabitable and wiping out all planetside residents. Vader took the lone surviving Jedi as another secret apprentice but was later forced by the Emperor to kill him.<ref name="Perfect Evil">"[[Perfect Evil]]"</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}

The details of the Purge are explained in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]]. In contrast, the movies show only Yoda and Obi-Wan as survivors while others are either killed or just not mentioned. Some think that this is what [[George Lucas]] actually intended, that according to [[Canon|G-canon]], the actual survivors were only two, which is supported by Yoda's line to Luke "The last of the Jedi you will be." This statement seems inaccurate if other Jedi were alive as late as after [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']], although it could simply refer to Jedi who are still following the teachings of the Order. Many of the survivors ceased to identify themselves as Jedi, despite having Jedi training, in order to exist in the changing galaxy and continue to evade the perpetrators of the Purge&mdash;so from a certain point of view, Yoda and Obi-Wan were the last of the open Jedi. Alternately, it could be that Yoda was simply unaware of other Jedi, or that the other Jedi had either already been hunted down or passed away. It is also important to note that during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], Obi-Wan changes the beacon in the Jedi Temple to warn any surviving members of the Order away, thus giving them a chance to escape the Purge.
